Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely confirmed the Ogallala Aquifer as the shallow aquifer near Ogallala without sufficient authoritative evidence, based solely on initial search results. This decision caused the loop to focus on depth-to-water data for the Ogallala Aquifer, neglecting the possibility of other shallow aquifers. This misinterpretation of upstream data set the task on an incorrect path, making it difficult to recover the correct reasoning later.
